ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Primary action buttons, active badges, accent borders — the system's only chromatic voice, used to signal interactivity and emphasis

ember-orange-link-variant.$description: Ember Orange (link variant) — Orange text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

carbon-black.$description: Carbon Black — Primary text, icons, image overlays, card headings — maximum contrast against white canvas

graphite.$description: Graphite — Headings, body emphasis, dark surface alternative — slightly softened black for large display text

slate-dark.$description: Slate Dark — List items, secondary body text, card content

stone.$description: Stone — Navigation labels, subdued body text

pewter.$description: Pewter — Muted descriptions, inactive list items, heading borders

mist.$description: Mist — Card borders, subtle button shadows — cool-tinted gray that defines container edges

cloud.$description: Cloud — Alternate card backgrounds, disabled surfaces

fog.$description: Fog — Neutral secondary button fill, placeholder surfaces

paper.$description: Paper — Hairline dividers, borders across all contexts — the structural neutral that separates sections

pearl.$description: Pearl — Card surfaces, subtle backgrounds, alternate section bands

canvas-white.$description: Canvas White — Page background, nav surface, card fill, button text — the dominant canvas

plus-jakarta-sans.$description: Sole typeface for all text — body, headings, nav, buttons, badges, icons. The wide weight range (300–800) carries the entire visual hierarchy; display sizes reach 80px at weight 300 for a light, expansive headline, while UI text sits at 14-16px weight 400-500
